main.description: A thread around an anchor post, for the caller. A block between the caller and an author hides that author's posts, as gaps, and nothing around them; a block between two other people changes nothing. Nothing by an author the caller has a block with is returned. The response always holds what getPostThread would return; it adds more only while the server can check the caller's blocks (see 'bridging'). Requires auth. Who may call is the server's setting: any signed-in account, or only members whose account is ready, in which case anyone else is refused NotEnrolled or NotReady. A caller that is not a ready member gets viewer.blockedBy and viewer.muted false in the views and no other viewer state. Merge responses by URI: a continuation can return a node the client already has. A reply the thread's root author hid is returned with hiddenByThreadgate rather than left out. The output has no threadgate field, and nothing of the gate of a root that is a gap is returned.

depth.description: How many levels of replies to include.

parentHeight.description: How many levels of parent posts to include.

repliesCursor.description: A cursor from a moreReplies marker on this same anchor.

nodes.description: The parent chain, root-most first; the anchor; then replies, level by level.

truncated.description: True when some node carries moreParents or moreReplies.

bridging.description: 'off': the server could not check the caller's blocks, and the response is what getPostThread would return. 'limited': it could, but at least one post was held back because its author could not be checked. 'full': nothing was held back for that reason. Tells the reader that a thread may be incomplete for want of a check, as opposed to a real block.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Malformed request body, a parameter out of range, or a repliesCursor that is not valid for this anchor.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a member.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account is not ready yet.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
